name: EliteAI Tools

sources.title: EliteAI.tools homepage - AI tools directory with 'Launch Your Tool' CTA
Submit new tool page - requires login; form body not rendered without auth

conditions: Submission requires an account — login via Google, GitHub, or email is enforced before the submit form renders
No public pricing for the base listing was visible; separate paid 'Promote Your Tool' and 'Guest Post' tabs exist at /tool/submit-new-tool?tab=promote
requirements: AI tools only — 'exclusively featuring high-quality, useful, and thoroughly tested tools' per the site
Curated directory — submissions are reviewed, not auto-published
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, pricing model, logo/screenshots
Relevant tags (directory organizes by 50+ tag pages like image-generation, video-creation) and profession fit
workflow: Go to https://eliteai.tools/tool/submit-new-tool ('Launch Your Tool' / 'Submit Your Tool' buttons)
Log in or sign up (Google, GitHub, or email)
Complete the submit-new-tool form (fields not publicly visible without auth)
Submit for review and wait for the curated listing
Optional paid routes: 'Promote Your Tool' tab and 'Guest Post' sub-tab on the same page
watchFor: Entire submit flow is behind authentication — cannot be completed or even previewed without an account
Separate paid promotion surface (?tab=promote) plus a guest-post upsell (?sub_tab=guest-blog-post) live inside the submit page
Site claims 'thoroughly tested tools' — thin or non-functional products may be rejected
countsAsLive: The tool appears on its tag/profession pages and is searchable via the site's AI-powered search
unknowns: Whether a free listing tier exists or all listings are paid (freemium per catalog note, unconfirmed on site)
Form fields behind the auth wall
Review timeline and whether the listing link is dofollow
Pricing for Promote Your Tool / Guest Post options
